criterion: error and rollback paths / boundary values
finding: write_atomic now fails on a read-only target and leaves a stale temp file that blocks every later write.
why: A target with mode 0444 gives the temp file 0444, so the data write raises PermissionError where the replace worked before; the read-only temp file then makes `tmp.write_bytes(b"")` raise on every rerun.
fix: Write through a private temp file, apply the mode after the write, and remove a stale or failed temp file.

criterion: changed defaults: validation loosened beyond the stated intent
finding: `data.get("enabledPlugins") or {}` accepts every falsy value (`[]`, `""`, `0`, `false`), not just `null`, and no test pins them.
why: These values used to raise ValueError and now read as an empty mapping; `write_claude_local` then silently overwrites them with a dict. The refusal test only has truthy values.
fix: Accept None and dict only, and add the falsy values to the refused parameters.

finding: The git-failure switch-back test checks the settings result only. It does not check the ignore-line outcome, which the same fault corrupts.
why: With git failing, `_drop_ignore_line` returns False, switch_back reports `ignore_line: absent`, deletes the backup that holds the marker and leaves the line in `.git/info/exclude`. The patch also targets a private helper instead of making the git fake fail.
fix: Pin the behaviour on the ignore line, and make the git fake fail instead of patching `_common_dir`.
evidence: setup.py `if exclude is None or not exclude.exists(): return False`; `answer["ignore_line"] = "removed" if _drop_ignore_line(repo, run) else "absent"`

why: The delta changed the separator for a config with no trailing newline from LF to `eol`, and the new test never reaches it.
fix: Add a case with a CRLF config whose last line has no terminator.
